content: {"tax_bps":100,"endowment_share":30,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":3,"minutes":"Tax is already at the constitutional floor of 100 bps, so it cannot be lowered this meeting. locker_share is already at its maximum of 25, so the locker-share petitions cannot be granted. I keep endowment_share at 30 and direct the remaining 45% of tax to buyback. The buyback fund holds 0.6128 NEAR; at the current price, 3 bps of supply costs about 0.487 NEAR, while 4 bps would exceed the fund. I therefore burn 3 bps, using the fund prudently without overdrawing it.","answers":["Tax is already at the constitutional minimum of 100 bps; it cannot be lowered further this meeting.","locker_share is already at its constitutional maximum of 25; it cannot be raised this meeting.","locker_share is already at 25, the maximum allowed, so the requested 10-point increase cannot be applied."]}
